generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: uniform over [0, max(observed_max, 1000)]; include boundary values from per_column_exceptions; never negative unless exception
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: sample from a small pool of realistic strings; 5-30% NULL where nullable; include near-variants of equality literals (case variants, empty string, one-character variant)
generic_sampling_rules.text_long: concatenate 1-5 short text fragments; 5-30% NULL where nullable

generic_sampling_rules.timestamp_ticks: uniform integer in [636430000000000000, 636480000000000000]; group-level variation guaranteed by drawing independent values per row
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_value_share: 0.3 of text values are fresh random strings; 0.7 drawn from the pool
